import numpy as np
import numpy as np
rng = np.random.default_rng(12)
w = rng.standard_normal((31, 50))
cov = w @ w.T
d = np.sqrt(np.diag(cov))
correlation = np.clip(cov / np.outer(d, d), -1.0, 1.0)
neighbours = np.full((31, 5), -1, dtype=int)
for m in range(1, 32):
    for c in range(5):
        t = m ^ (1 << c)
        neighbours[m - 1, c] = t - 1 if t >= 1 else -1
threshold = 7.0
assert np.allclose(compute_dlm_pvalue(correlation, neighbours, threshold), target)
